## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak sector breadth plus mixed leadership (Utilities/Energy strength vs split Technology), and major short-term divergences among large caps — suppresses a directional regime call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +3.66%). Utilities strong: VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%). Financials mixed but constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%), Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Communication lagging: TTWO BELOW TREND (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%). Materials weak: representative names underperforming; Industrials soft overall with UNP BELOW TREND (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) and LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%). Leadership concentrated across Industrials/Utilities/Technology; style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: UNP BELOW TREND (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%), LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%), PLTR CORRECTION (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%). Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Highest 1W moves: DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%). Watch INTC RECOVERY and MSFT CORRECTION for divergence; this looks tactical, not broad-based.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with divergence: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +10.67%) vs MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) and GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%). Tech shows concentrated strength in AI names but breadth is uneven; treat as selective.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Cautious constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) while V CORRECTION (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) and MA CORRECTION (1W: -2.70% | 1M: +0.57%). Financials showing internal rotation with modest net 1W gain; monitor earnings/news flow.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Flat-to-positive internally: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +8.59%), UNH RECOVERY (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) while LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%). Sector breadth muted; news catalysts (FDA approvals, earnings) will drive dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Utilities exposure given above-trend names and earnings-driven momentum; reduce exposure to lagging Industrials and weak Communication names. Monitor tech leaders (NVDA, META) for follow-through and treat INTC and MSFT divergences as tactical opportunities rather than core shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%), DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%).  
BEARISH: UNP BELOW TREND (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%), LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%), PANW BELOW TREND (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -7.30%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +13.73%) and Utilities (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) — momentum and M&A headlines. BEARISH: Communication and Industrials — widening underperformance and headline risk in select names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: hold 1M trend for continuation (ABOVE TREND confirmation); AAPL: watch the near-term support band around recent consolidation (ABOVE TREND); JPM: watch for breakout above recent 1M highs to confirm Financials follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (+55): UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY — earnings beat sentiment aligns with short-term strength but 1M remains negative, so partial confirmation. AVGO/ASML/AMD show bullish headlines in feeds but full 1W/1M confirmation is mixed across Technology names (selective follow-through required).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MSFT (-50): MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION — negative legal headlines confirm near-term weakness and increase event risk. AAPL (-50): AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND — negative lawsuit headlines diverge from price, watch for distribution. WMT (-50): WMT (1W: +3.93% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — DOJ probe headlines create downside risk despite short-term bounce.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NVDA ABOVE TREND, META ABOVE TREND and MPC ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is the major divergence across large caps (MSFT/AAPL/INTC) and thin breadth (4/11 sectors positive) — watch headlines and confirm trend breaks.
